guide.nedra.page.1:
§1§lNEDRA§r
§8Miner's handbook§r

The world is now 288 blocks deeper: it ends at §lY -352§r. The deeper you go, the harder the rock presses down.

§8Lost this book? §0/nedra guide§8 gives a new one.

guide.nedra.page.3:
§1§lPressure§r

Above Y 0 the world is normal. Below zero the deep begins: pressure grows from 0% to 100% at the bottom, Y -352.

A gauge appears at the lower right: level, tier, height, protection. Details: §0/nedra info§r.
guide.nedra.page.4:
§1§lPressure tiers§r

§2Low§r 10%+: bearable.
§2Moderate§r 30%+: mining gets slower.
§6High§r 55%+: the rock groans, F3 glitches.
§4Severe§r 75%+: heartbeat, darkening vision.
§4§lCritical§r 92%+: the rock hurts you, but never kills.
guide.nedra.page.5:
§1§lProtection§r

A helmet takes off part of the pressure:
§8•§r Hard hat: %1$s%%
§8•§r Reinforced: %2$s%%
§8•§r Deepsuit: %3$s%%

A tablet adds %4$s%% more for %5$s. Total is capped at 95%%.
guide.nedra.page.6:
§1§lHelmets§r

§lHard hat:§r 4 iron ingots and a lumenite crystal.

§lReinforced:§r a hard hat and 5 magnetite ingots.

§lDeepsuit:§r a reinforced helmet, 5 magnetite, glass and 2 resonant shards.
guide.nedra.page.7:
§1§lMoss and tablets§r

§2Deepmoss§r glows on cave floors below Y -24. A hoe cuts it fastest.

2 clumps of moss and sugar make 2 tablets. You can take them even when full.
guide.nedra.page.8:
§1§lCave-ins§r

§4Unstable stone§r sheds dust. Mining near it is risky: the ceiling cracks and you have 2 seconds to run.

Below Y 0 ceilings sometimes fall even without it. Without Silk Touch it drops gravel.
guide.nedra.page.9:
§1§lAir currents§r

An §3air vent§r in a cave floor blasts air upward and lifts whoever stands above it.

The jet cancels fall damage, so it makes a natural elevator. Cover the vent with a block to stop it.
guide.nedra.page.10:
§1§lLumenite§r

A glowing ore of the deep, found below Y -32. Needs an iron pickaxe.

Drops 1-2 crystals, Fortune adds more. 4 crystals and glass make a §llumenite lamp§r, as bright as glowstone.
guide.nedra.page.11:
§1§lMagnetite§r

A dark ore found below Y -64. Smelt raw magnetite into ingots.

Magnetite confuses compasses: within %1$s blocks of the ore the needle spins wildly. Walk away and it settles.
guide.nedra.page.12:
§1§lEcho ore§r

A rare ore below Y -96. Easier to hear than to see: a faint crystal chime rings nearby.

Drops a §3resonant shard§r, the heart of the geophone and the deepsuit.
guide.nedra.page.13:
§1§lGeophone§r

Shard on top, copper on the sides and bottom, magnetite in the middle.

Right-click to sound the rock within %1$s blocks: signal, ore, direction and distance. The echo comes from the ore.
guide.nedra.page.14:
§1§lDeep biomes§r

§5Echo Hollows§r, Y -80 to -176: flat halls with pillars, tuff, sculk.
§8Magnetic Caverns§r, -176 to -272: tall shafts, basalt, magma.
§3Crystal Depths§r, below -272: calcite, amethyst, lakes.
guide.nedra.page.15:
§1§lCaverns and water§r

Two networks of underground rivers, near Y -116 and Y -228, run for hundreds of blocks.

Iron, gold and diamonds hide in the deepslate. Lava only at the very bottom.
guide.nedra.page.16:
§1§lSettlements§r

Abandoned miner towns: a huge hall with houses, streets, lamps, a well and chests.

/nedra info, /nedra guide

/nedra reload
guide.nedra.page.17:
§1§lRust Brute§r

A miner zombie of the §8Magnetic Caverns§r: red and a third taller than you. Slow but tough, its heavy blow slows you briefly.

Does not burn in sunlight. Drops raw iron, sometimes magnetite.
